༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bya rog gi mtshan can gyi gtor chen brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal ba las rim gsal sgron la sbyar ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bya rog gi mtshan can gyi gtor chen brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal ba las rim gsal sgron la sbyar ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa sngags pas bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ las dang mthun pa'i gnas su nyams su blang ba la/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor gsum ste/ de'ang dper na zhag dgu lta bur byed na zhag gsum bsnyen pa/ gsum sgrub pa/ gsum las sbyor bya ste des 'gre bar rgyun ring thung gang byed de'i cha gsum du byas pa'i dang po bsnyen pa/ gnyis pa sgrub pa/ gsum pa las sbyor bya'o// de yang dang po dkyil 'khor bca' ba ni/ stegs bu rgya dpangs gnas khang gi go skabs yang dog bstun pa sa gru bzhi pa 'jam par byas pa'i rnam lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas chag chag btab par/ dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar gru gsum mthing nag zla gam dmar po/ gru gsum gyi lte bar 'bru nag gi tshom bu che ba gcig /gru gsum du de'i phyed tsam gsum/ gru gsum gyi zur gcig mdun du bstan/ phyi'i zla gam g.yas g.yon gnyis la tshom bu re re/ pad 'dab brgyad la tshom bu brgyad bkod| de'i phyi rdo ra dur khrod me ri rnams kyang dgos te tshom bu ma gtogs thams cad rdul tshon gyis bri/ de'i dbus su shing gi om gsum byas pa'i steng du/ lcags slang chen po'i nang 'bru nag gis bkang ba'i steng du 'bru nag la mi rta gnyis sogs kyi sha khrag dang dug dang chang gis sbags pa'i dpal bshos nag po khru gang tsam bca' ste/ de'i logs gsum du dpal chung gtso bo'i cha gsum du byas pa'i cha gnyis slebs pa re re/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon du gru gsum tal mo re re/ de'i phyi skor du dpal chung gsum las chung tsam pa'i gru gsum tal mo brgyad kyis bskor/ mtshams rnams su ong skyur sha khrag bran/ gtor ma thams cad dmar nag tu bya/ las 'jam gsum la dkar rgyan btab| drag po la mi dgos gtso 'khor thams cad kyi tsaka li yod na gtor ma so sor btsugs/

med kyang gtso bo'i gtor mar bris sku dang dar nag gi gdugs kyis brgyan/ om gyi zur gsum gyi rtse mor dar nag gi rgyal mtshan bsgreng*/ om gyi bar rnams me tog nag po'i phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi lda ldi dang*/ spos kyi ring bus bskor ba bsgreng*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams kyang bca'/ dkyil 'khor gyi rol du thod pa'i nang du khrag chen gyi mchod yon/ chang gi zhabs bsil/ dung chu'i 'thor 'thung*/ dbang po lnga dang dug lnga'i me tog /sha chen gyi gu gul/ btsan dug yungs kar sgog skya rnams sbyar ba'i spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ dug khrag mkhris chen dang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bru nag gi zan sha khrag rus par bcas pa'i lha bshos/ mi rkang thod rnga sogs kyi rol mo rnams g.yon skor du bshams/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma'ang logs shig tu mchod pa dang bcas te bshams/ logs shig tu bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang mgon po'i rkang brgyad sgra mi 'chad par klog mi zhig kyang bzhag /rang nyid stan la 'dug nas bde mgon gyi las rim gsal sgron gyi sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas bzung bde mchog gi bsnyen mtshams bar byas la/ yig bdun gtso bor byas pa'i bzlas pa ci 'grub byas rjes gtor chen la dmigs pas/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he dang swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i brag ri nas bstod pa'i bar mdun bskyed las rim gsal sgron ltar byas rjes/ las rim gsal sgron gyi lhan thabs bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag ltar dmigs pa dang bcas pa rtsa ba'i snying po 'bru bdun pa dang*/ nye snying 'bru dgu pa/ myur du dgug pa'i snying po yi ge bcu pa/ brtan par bzhugs shing gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i snying po 'bru bcu gsum pa ci 'grub re bzlas rjes/ srog gi snying po ches zab pa 'bru bco lnga pa nyid gtso bor 'bad pas mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas/

thun mjug rnams su bya gdong gsum/ seng gdong yum/ mkha' 'gro brgyad kyi sngags rnams kyang ci 'grub re bzla/ thun mtshams rnams su gtor chen la sha zan sman raka sgron la gtor ma rgyas par bya zhing rkang pa brgyad pas bstod do// de ltar bsnyen pa thems nas sgrub pa ni/ gzhan thams cad gong ltar la yig 'bru bco lnga pa thung tsam bzlas rjes yig 'bru bco lnga pa dang*/ shā sa na sbrel la mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla/ thun mtshams rnams su gtor bsngos kyi mthar rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dgong mo srod thun la tshogs mchod dang mnga' gsol bskang bshags kyang bya'o// de ltar bsgrubs nas las la sbyar ba ni/ dpal bshos brgya rtsa brgyad gtor chen gyi mdun ngos su bsham/ rang gi g.yon ngos su chang phud la a mṛ ta btab pa dang*/ sran ma sogs 'bru sna dang shing thog sna tshogs dang sman sna tshogs pa bzhag /g.yas phyogs su sha khrag gis sbags pa'i mtheb skyu nya sha la sogs pa'i sha dum brgya rtsa brgyad bzhag /las thams cad la dgos pa yin no// bye brag tu bsrung ba la srung 'khor bris la gtor gdugs khrod du btags la/ gtor ma 'bul khar rang ngam gang bsrung ba'i mgul du btags/ zlog pa zlog 'khor tshar lnga bris pa gtor chen gyi gnas lngar bcug /mnan bsad la dkyil 'khor gyi lhor brub khung rtsang gis brgyan pa'i nang du mnan ling bcer ba'i khar bsad pa'i 'khor lo tshar gnyis bris la bcer ba'i rdo rje dang phur bu sogs kyis mnan la dar nag gis bkab la/ bsad mnan la thun drug tu 'gugs dbye bstan srung mtshon cha ltar/ nan khyer bya zhing skad rigs bzhi'i sngags nan khyer sngags kyi thems yig nang gsungs pa'i bsad pa sngags kyi spu gri sogs bzla mi mthun rdzas la btab/ khug rtags mthong nas thun brab phur bu btab rbod gtong bsgral las sogs bstan srung mtshon cha ltar/ gi las bya'o// 'khor lo zlog bsad mnan pa/

rnams kyi 'bri lugs ni 'gro mgon ti shri ras pas mdzad pa'i gtor chen gyi yig char gsal ba ltar bya/ dgra'i zag rdzas rnams kyang byug /bgegs yin na gang gnod de yi sa rdul/ ngos ma zin na 'dre 'tshubs byas shul gyi sa byug /bsad mnan la zan gyi nya bo brgya rtsa brgyad dug gis sbags pa do gal che na khong par ming rus gri khrag gis bris pa bcug /dri mas byugs pa bsham mo// bdag mdun bskyed pa sogs sgrub pa'i skabs ltar la 'jam gsum srung zlog sogs la sngags kyang sgrub pa'i skabs ltar zlog bsad mnan la skad cig bzhi la sngags bsad pa sngags kyi spu gri sogs/ gtso cher bzla/ tshogs mchod bya lhag ma btang*/ brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul ba ni/ mchod g.yog pas ka pā la'i nang du dpal gtor brgya rtsa brgyad nas gcig bshams/ mtheb skyur 'bru chan dang sman raka bran/ bsad pa yin na nya bo rnams la 'gugs dbye phur thun bsgral chog rnams bstan srung mtshon cha ltar rdzogs par byas rjes dpal gtor gyi zlar nya bo re yang bcug pa thogs la rang nyid rdor dril 'dzin pas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ lan gsum gyis dri ma bkrus| oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can gyi 'od kyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur par bsam mo// shā sa na tshar bdun bzlas/ mchod g.yog pa'i lag gi gtor ma de gtor chen la bstab/ rang gis dril bu 'khrol/ sgrub g.yog yod na rol chen bya/ tshul de lta bus dpal gtor brgya rtsa brgyad po thems par 'bul zhing*/ de'i ring sha chen sogs sbyar ba'i spos bsreg /de'ang zhi rgyas dbang gsum la shā sa na bdun po'i phyi ma'i mthar las gang sgrub kyi 'dod gsol bya/ rang gi 'chi bslu sogs la dpal gtor rang nyid kyi glud du 'bul/ do gal che na dpal gtor re dang ngar glud re sbrags pa 'bul/

nyams chags skong na bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ nad pa'i don byed na nad pa de'i gnod byed kyi sha khrag tu dmigs pas 'bul lo// yang rang gi grogs dang slob ma snying nye zhing dam sel med pa'i rim 'gro byed na'ang de ltar bya/ gzhan phal pa la bya mi rung*/ bsad pa yin na dpal gtor nya bo dang bcas dgra bgegs de'i sha khrag tu dmigs la 'bul/ de rnams gang byed kyang shā sa na bdun po'i phyi ma'i mthar 'dod gsol bya/ bsad zlog la dmod pa bya zhing thal mo brdab/ de ltar brgya rtsa thems nas slar gtor chen la sha zan sman raka gtor ma bran byin gyis brlabs shing*/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā lā ka wu wa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang slar gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags re re'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa nyer gcig re dang so so'i mtshan dang bcas pas gtor bsngos rgyas par bya zhing 'dod gsol bya/ yi ge brgya pa lan nyer gcig bzlas pas chad lhag bskang*/ sran ma la rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas gtor chen la gtor zhing mnga' gsol bya'o// rkang brgyad sogs gtso 'khor rnams kyi bstod pa dang bskang bshags bya/ rang ngam nad pa'am mched grogs slob ma dam ldan sogs chags che ba'i mtshan ma yod na de la gtor chen gyi dbang byas na shin tu zab/ su rung la mi bya/ de ltar zhag grangs mang nyung gang yin yang nub tha mar bsad mnan yin na/ bsad 'khor gcig thun phur gri mtshon gyis bsgral la dpal bshos dang nya bo brgya rtsa dang lhan cig gtor mar 'bul/ bsad 'khor gcig dug shing gi hom la yug sa'i me sbar ba mgon po bzhi 'khor bcas su bskyed la/ zan gyi nya bo sha zan 'bru chan dang bsad 'khor dum bur gtub pa dang sbrags shā sa na'i mjug me ke na che ge mo mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes brgya'am nyer gcig gis dbul/

dmod pa bya/ thal mo brdab/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu byas la/ me dug khrag gis gzhil lam thal sol dang mnan 'khor la sngags kyi them yig nas gsungs pa'i mnan sngags rtags ldan du bzlas rjes thod pa mtshan ngan nam/ spyang dar ma'i thod pa'am/ sha khyi'i thod par mnan chas dang ldan pas mnan pa sogs drag las spyi gzhung ltar byas pas 'grub/ mthar gtor chen lhar bskyed pa la/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol byas la ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ las 'jam gsum la gtor ma byin brlabs la bdud rtsi dang 'dod yon du bsam/ dpal 'bar spar/ spos ring gtams| phyir spags/ chos skyong bcu bskul gyis gtor ma bskyangs la rang gi khang thog gam gtsang sar stegs kyi khar 'bul/ drag po la gtor chen las kyi dmag tshogs su bsams la dpal rga los bsil ba'i tshal du zhal gzigs dus kyi bstod bskul ring bas drag tu bskul dgra phyogs sam thebs thog tu 'phang*/ gtor mnan gzhung ltar bya'o// gang ltar ram nang du 'ongs nas gtor skyel la srung ba dang yi ge brgyad pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod gshegs bsdu bya/ shis brjod dang bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// 'di ni rang don du dus khyad par can la bya ba'i rang gi rim gro dang 'chi bslu/ rang gi rdo rje slob dpon nam/ mched grogs sam| slob ma dam ldan gyi rim gro'am/ zhi rgyas dbang drag zlog bsad mnan pa'i do gal la thug pa'i tshe bya'i/ gzhan gal med la bya ba'am/ mi nag phal pa dang bstan la gnod pa'i rna bar 'di'i ming tsam yang bsgrag par mi bya la/ 'di'i phan yon ni/ rang gi nyams chag skong*/ dngos grub myur/ bar chad sel/ dgra bgegs thul/ bsam pa'i don 'grub/ mthar bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs nas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob ste/ des bstan pa skyong bar the tshom med do// zhes rga lo'i dngos slob cog gru chos rgyal gyis gsungs so|

|de ltar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bya rog mtshan can gyi gtor chen brgya rtsa brgyad las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i lag len gyi brjed byang bde mgon sgrub pa'i las rim gsal sgron rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa la sbyar ba 'di/ dpal rga lo'i slob ma cog gru chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa dang*/ 'gro mgon ti shri ras pas mdzad pa gnyis gtso bor bzung gzhan yang gtor chen brgya rtsa'i yig cha rnying pa mang rabs 'dug pa rnams kyis kha bskangs nas lag len 'khrul med ngag 'don du bsgrigs pa 'di ni shing lug smin drug zla ba'i nyer lnga la/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong sngags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba yin la/ 'di nyid lag tu blang ba'i tshe las rim gsal sgron gyis khog phub/ 'jam gsum las gzhan pa'i kha 'gengs mi dgos/ drag las la liṅga bskyed pa 'gugs dbye thun brab phur gdab bsgral chog rnams| rje btsun dam pa ratnas mdzad pa'i gtor zlog bya mgo ma'i las bsgrigs bstan srung mtshon cha nas kha bskang na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba yod// //maṅga laṃ//
